ai_summary.text:
アトラエはAI活用の採用プラットフォーム「Green」とエンゲージメントツール「Wevox」を展開するHRテック企業。成功報酬型の転職サービスGreenを主力に、組織のエンゲージメント可視化ツールWevoxでSaaS事業も展開している。

売上76億円（前年比-11.2%）と減収。営業利益19億円（営業利益率24.3%）、純利益12億円。売上は減少したが、24%超の高い営業利益率を維持しており収益性は強固。ROE22.5%と極めて高い資本効率。

自己資本比率60.3%、財務健全性スコア95点。営業CF19億円、FCF14億円とほぼ全額がFCFとして残る。EPS49円に対しPER15.6倍、配当31円。IT人材の転職市場は活発で、AIマッチングの精度が採用効率を左右する時代においてGreenの技術力が競争優位を支えている。なお、EPS49.3円、PER15.6倍、1株当たり配当金31.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: Atrae is an HR tech company that develops the AI-powered recruitment platform "Green" and the engagement tool "Wevox." It mainly operates the success-based job change service Green and also develops the SaaS business with the organization's engagement visualization tool Wevox.  Revenue is  7.6 billion (down 11.2% year-on-year), a decrease. Operating profit is  1.9 billion (operating profit margin of 24.3%) and net profit is  1.2 billion. Although revenue decreased, it maintains a high operating profit margin of over 24%, and profitability is strong. Extremely high capital efficiency with ROE of 22.5%.  Equity ratio is 60.3% and financial soundness score is 95 points. Operating CF is  1.9 billion and FCF is  1.4 billion, with almost all of it remaining as FCF. EPS is  49, with a PER of 15.6x and a dividend of  31. The IT human resources job market is active, and Green's technological capabilities support its competitive advantage in an era where the accuracy of AI matching affects recruitment efficiency. EPS is  49.3, PER is 15.6x, and dividend per share is  31.0, and the company is promoting management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement.
